title: Reduce hero banner height by half and show only one quote (UZ)

requirements.summary: Reduce the hero banner image height on the Gallery page to exactly half its current value
acceptanceCriteria: The hero banner section height is 50% of its previous height.
The banner image still fills the reduced height correctly (no white space or overflow).
Layout below the banner is not broken.

file_operations.description: Update the hero banner section's height-related CSS classes or inline styles to reduce the current height by exactly 50%. If the banner uses h-[600px], change it to h-[300px]. If it uses h-screen, change to h-[50vh]. Ensure the background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-light-art.dim_1920x1080.png) maintains proper cover/fill behavior. Verify that no visual artifacts (white space, overflow, or cut-off content) are introduced and that the layout elements below the banner remain properly positioned.

requirements.summary: Display only the UZ quote (Russell 'Geheimnis des Lichtes') in the hero banner, removing the Goethe quote and all rotation logic
acceptanceCriteria: Only one quote is displayed in the banner — the Russell 'Geheimnis des Lichtes' (UZ) quote.
The Goethe quote is no longer shown.
No rotation animation or carousel indicator is present.
The quote text is legible against the banner background.

file_operations.description: Remove the rotating quotes array/state and carousel logic from the hero banner. Keep only the Russell 'Geheimnis des Lichtes' (UZ) quote as a static text element. Remove the Goethe quote entirely. Delete any interval timers, animation transitions, carousel indicators (dots), or state management related to quote rotation. Ensure the remaining single quote is properly styled, centered, and readable against the banner background. Remove any dependencies on quote rotation such as useEffect hooks, currentQuoteIndex state, or animation classes.
